Lead IT projects end-to-end — migrations, platform deployments, infrastructure upgrades — with cross-functional stakeholder management. Specific platform experience can be substituted for a demonstrated ability to learn quickly. Expertise in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, hybrid identity management, and identity federation protocols (SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM). Solid understanding of Azure IaaS/PaaS, Azure RBAC, Azure Policy, and Azure Monitor; PowerShell scripting for automation; working knowledge of core networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPN, firewalls). Experience with endpoint management (Intune, SCCM, or Jamf) and ITSM/ticketing platforms (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent); understanding of IT security frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001). Familiarity with the broader SaaS environment, including Tableau, Snowflake, Salesforce, NetSuite, Atlassian, DocuSign, AWS, and GitHub. Leadership attributes: ownership, accountability, and the ability to communicate and build trust across every level of the organization. Strong project management and organizational skills; able to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and shifting priorities. High customer-service orientation and comfort with ambiguity; a self-starter who stays organized without close direction. Working Conditions Primarily remote, with occasional travel to office locations for hardware installations, site assessments, or vendor meetings. After-hours and weekend availability, plus participation in an on-call rotation, is required for planned maintenance, system emergencies, and critical incident response. Must be comfortable operating in server room/wiring closet environments and occasionally lifting IT equipment up to 50 lbs. The anticipated annual base salary is between $110,000 - $125,000 annually. Final pay rate will be determined based on experience, qualifications and geographic location. The hiring organization is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.
